Row.Text: Contempt towards the leadership has become popular amongst the new city in the empire, blaming all problems, big and small, on the choices we've made. While this is hopefully a passing phase, a continued lack of domestic support will be viewed as a major weakness in the empire. What do you suppose we do?
We live in a free society. Let them say what they want.
We should encourage teachings of the more positive aspects of our nation...
Throw any scums that disrespect our empire in jail for disloyalty!
